title: Seat Subsystem Dynamic Attributes
description: Dynamic attributes of the seat: seat position, signal transmission targets, and per-installation overrides of presentation settings declared by the model definition.

definition.description: Resource location of the subsystem model, pointing to the corresponding subsystem static attribute definition file.

locator.description: Seat point locator name, bones in the model will serve as seat position. If empty, use the default locator defined by the subsystem.

control_group_preset.description: Resource location of the control group preset, defining the available control channel mappings for this seat. e.g. machine_max:default_driver.

passenger_num_outputs.description: Passenger count signal output channel and targets.

camera_discovery_targets.description: Camera discovery handshake configuration. Subsystems on these channels will receive handshake signals to discover available cameras on this vehicle. e.g. {"gunner_optics": ["gunner_primary_sight"]}

dismount_locators.description: Ordered list of dismount locator names; the list order is the priority for dismount attempts. Every name must exist in the model locators; an empty list means this seat declares no dismount point.

first_hud_layout.description: Per-installation override of the first-person HUD layout. Omit to keep the model definition's views.first_hud_layout; write machine_max:empty to show no HUD in first person at this seat.

third_hud_layout.description: Per-installation override of the third-person HUD layout. Omit to keep the model definition's views.third_hud_layout; write machine_max:empty to show no HUD in third person at this seat.

allow_use_items.description: Per-installation override of whether the occupant may use items. Omit to keep the model definition's allow_use_items.
